evidence: Based on the results of the X-ray di!raction measurement and secondary ion mass spectroscopy, we found that the lattice parameter of the AlAs epilayer was decreased with increasing carbon concentration [C]. Hall measurements revealed that carbon acts as a p-type dopant in AlAs. The lattice parameters of ALE-grown AlAs layers were measured with a double-crystal X-ray di!raction (XRD). Atomic carbon concentrations, which were measured by secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS), were calibrated with carbon ion implanted standards. The carrier type and concentration were determined by the Van der Pauw method using In}Ga ohmic electrodes.
